tokens.name: oxide
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Logo petals, primary buttons, key highlights. As a fill under text use on-oxide (5.4:1 light, 5.6:1 dark). Not for body text — use oxide-text.

tokens.name: oxide-text
tokens.usage: Links and inline emphasis in oxide on surface-100 (6.1:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-oxide
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an oxide fill.

tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: Deep brand ground: app icon, hero bands, social cards. Paper text on it is 12:1; bloom on it 7.2:1.

tokens.name: bloom
tokens.usage: Soft tint for petals on oxblood, highlight panels and badges. Ink on bloom 9.9:1 light; ink on bloom 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: sprout
tokens.usage: Growth and success: passing builds, 'stable' badges, terminal prompts. 5.1:1 light, 9.0:1 dark on surface-100. Never the brand colour, and never Spring's leaf green.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, the logo's hex nut and wordmark. 16.7:1 light, 16.0:1 dark on surface-100.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, taglines. 6.3:1 light, 7.7:1 dark on surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background — warm paper, or forge-dark.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, code windows' chrome on paper, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Sunken wells: code blocks, quiet bands between sections.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and card borders. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons (3.3:1+ on surface-100 in both themes).

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code window body — always dark, in both themes.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Default code text on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords and attributes (#[component], fn, impl) on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings and success output on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments on code-bg (5.4:1).
